name: lily-studio
description: A small desktop studio for LilyPond scores: files, editor and preview in one fixed window.

scripts.test:unit: npm run test:rust && node esbuild.mjs --tests && node --test "out/test/*.test.js"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke
scripts.dist: tauri build --bundles app && APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE=lily-notary node scripts/dmg.mjs
scripts.dist:x64: tauri build --bundles app --target x86_64-apple-darwin && APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE=lily-notary node scripts/dmg.mjs --target x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.dist:local: tauri build --bundles app --config src-tauri/tauri.local.json && node scripts/dmg.mjs --local
scripts.test:e2e: npm run dist && node esbuild.mjs --e2e && node --test "out/test/e2e/*.test.js"
